title: plugin-security: discard-overlay deletes the only stored row of a permission set saved into a writable runtime package — its eligibility reads "has a package id" as "package-declared", the defect #21789 fixes in the lock
body:
This card takes the discard-overlay eligibility half of the "a package id read as shipped by code" family. Parent #21789 keeps the lock and the layered-read echo (PR #21857). Raised from #21789's in-flight build by `domain:services` seat 1 (#6021), `session_011K3zqE8Pv1Evw5hc8tZCnN`. The seat owns it with the parent's domain and priority, and dispatches it directly.

**What is measured** (the showcase, on `088428fb` and again on #21789's branch at `e9dff47f`):
- A permission set saved into a writable runtime package, then listed through the metadata read (which stamps the row's package id onto the body), then sent through `POST /api/v1/security/permission-sets/:id/discard-overlay`, gets `200`.
- **The set's only `sys_metadata` row is deleted.**
- The action declares, and `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx` repeats, that it refuses any set that is not currently package-declared. So it should never destroy an environment-authored set. Here it destroys one: data loss through an explicit admin action whose contract says it cannot.

**Mechanism, as the dev read it (verify before acting):**
- `discardPermissionSetOverlay`'s eligibility (`permission-set-overlay-discard.ts`) finds the declared set with `_packageId ?? packageId`.
- `computePermissionSetDriftDiagnostics` (`permission-set-drift.ts`) has the same reading in its declared filter.
- Both treat a writable runtime package's row as code-shipped.

**Done when:**
- Discard refuses a set that no code (artifact) package ships, using the platform's one classifier for that question (`classifyPackagedPermissionSet`, or whatever #21789 settled on). No second evaluator.
- The drift diagnostics judge the same population.
- A pin discards a code-shipped set's overlay as before, and a door pin proves a runtime-package set, an org-owned set and a clone are refused, with every row intact.

**Positions:** `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/permission-set-overlay-discard.ts` and `permission-set-drift.ts`, which are disjoint from PR #21857's files.
